module.title: Connecting Your Tools via MCP
module.outcome: Your business tools connected to Claude Code via MCP

sections.title: What is MCP?
sections.content: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI tools like Claude Code talk to your business software. Think of it as a universal adapter — instead of building custom integrations for each tool, MCP provides a standard way to connect.
key_benefits: Secure — your data stays in your tools
Standardized — same pattern for every connection

sections.title: How to Add an MCP Connection
sections.content: Adding an MCP server to Claude Code takes one command. After that, Claude can interact with that tool directly.
general_steps: Run the install command: claude mcp add <name> -- <server-command>
Authenticate if prompted (API key or OAuth)
Test by asking Claude about your data in that tool
Verify the connection works both ways (if bidirectional)

common_issues.solution: Check Node.js version (16+ required). Run: node --version. Update if needed: nvm install --lts
API key may be expired or invalid. Regenerate in the vendor's settings. For OAuth, try: claude mcp remove <name> then re-add
Check permissions — the API key may not have access to the data you're querying. Verify in the vendor's admin panel
Some vendors limit API calls. Wait a few minutes and try again. Consider caching for frequently accessed data
